create_DataConsumer: create a DataConsumer dataclass instance to represent a consumer of a module output with consumer, input index, and output index
review_DataConsumer: review the DataConsumer generic dataclass used to represent a consumer of an output of a module in distributed pipeline
summarize_DataConsumer: summarize the DataConsumer dataclass fields including consumer, consumer_input_idx, and output_idx for pipeline module wiring
test_DataConsumer: test the DataConsumer dataclass instantiation with a consumer object and integer input and output indices
